root_message: {path} is not an allowed file at the repository root. Move it under the directory it belongs to, or delete it; scratch text, PR bodies and logs go under /tmp, never in the worktree. If the root file is intended, add it to root_files in scripts/path_policy.json in this PR
deny_message: {path} is a scratch, log or generated file and does not belong in a change. Remove it from the commit (git rm --cached {path}) and keep such files under /tmp
extension_message: {path} has a type that {where} does not hold (allowed: {allowed}). Put the file in the directory for its type, or delete it; if the type is intended there, add it to extensions in scripts/path_policy.json in this PR
unknown_dir_message: {path} is in a top-level directory the policy does not list. Move it into an existing directory, or add the directory to extensions in scripts/path_policy.json in this PR

names.message: {path} breaks the docs naming convention: a file directly in docs/ is README.md, logo.svg or YYYY-MM-DD.name.type.md with type draft, research or ref (docs/README.md). Rename it, or move it into the docs subdirectory it belongs to
{path} breaks the runbook convention docs/runbooks/YYYY-MM-DD.<slug>.ref.md (lowercase slug). Rename it
{path} breaks the spec convention docs/specs/<slug>.spec.md (lowercase slug, no date). Rename it
{path} breaks the draft convention docs/drafts/YYYY-MM-DD.<slug>.draft.md. Rename it
{path} breaks the research convention docs/research/YYYY-MM-DD.<slug>.research.md. Rename it
{path} breaks the report convention docs/reports/YYYY-MM-DD.<slug>.ref.md. Rename it
{path} breaks the postmortem convention docs/postmortems/YYYY-MM-DD.<slug>.ref.md. Rename it
{path} breaks the release note convention docs/releases/YYYY-MM-DD.vX-Y-Z.ref.md. Rename it

size_message: {path} is {size} bytes, over the {limit} byte limit for a new file. Do not commit it; if it is a real asset, add its path to large_files in scripts/path_policy.json in this PR
binary_message: {path} is a binary file outside the directories that hold binaries (binary_dirs: {allowed}). Do not commit it; images belong in assets/ or docs/, anything else is generated and stays out of the repo
